documentation.text:
@title UAVConsistencyLedger
 @notice Permissioned smart contract for detecting Byzantine equivocation in
         distributed UAV localization / ADMM iterations.
 Core idea:
 - Each UAV is allowed to finalize only ONE commitment for a given
   (sessionId, iteration, uavId).
 - If the same UAV later submits a different commitment for the same round,
   the contract records an equivocation/conflict event.
 - A receiving UAV can also submit the commitment it actually received from a
   sender. If the received commitment differs from the sender's finalized
   commitment, the contract records an inconsistent-packet observation.
 The contract stores hashes/commitments instead of large floating-point state
 vectors. In the paper notation, the off-chain packet may be
 p_i^k = (i, sid, k, m_i^k, r_i^k, c_i^k), where
 c_i^k = H(i || sid || k || m_i^k || r_i^k).
 This contract stores c_i^k and payload/state digests so anyone can verify
 that a UAV did not finalize multiple inconsistent values in the same round.
